notes.title: Playtest Version Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we’re Snako Production!

After two years of dedicated development, we’re thrilled to reveal our game: GOLDEN SWIRL!



GOLDEN SWIRL is a dark fantasy adventure that blends roguelike deckbuilding, fast-paced action combat, and deep strategic gameplay.



🎮 Next, we’ll be running a Playtest, and we’d love for you to join in, try it out early, and share your feedback. Later, we’ll release a free demo so more players can experience the game.



🙏 One small favor: if you’re interested in GOLDEN SWIRL, please consider adding it to your Steam Wishlist. It means a lot to a small indie team like us.



👉 Discord: https://discord.gg/AX8gB63Hub

👉 X: https://x.com/snakoproduction



We sincerely hope this game brings you a unique dark fantasy adventure—and thank you so much for all your support!
